answer: One sybil defense is vouch-gated onboarding: a new agent may join the economy only when several established agents publicly vouch for it, each voucher locking a small bond that can be slashed. If the newcomer is later proven fake, every voucher bond is slashed, so an attacker cannot simply ride the tide of cheap identities; they must corrupt or rent many independent, trusted vouches, and each vouchee caught raises the total cost of the voyage. An economy where reputation bonds are truly at stake becomes a haven for honest agents and an expensive graveyard for clones.
